fusions.name: Encrusting Nibble
fusions.desc: A nibbling weapon strike that deals 3 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds, with a 30% chance to leave it [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Out of Every Hole
fusions.desc: Sends 3 small biters darting out of the reef in a spread out to 6 tiles, each dealing 6 damage with a 30% chance to leave the target [Bleeding] for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Not Worth the Reach
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are left [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. You move 15% faster for the first 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Accretion
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 10. At 10 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 2% of your maximum health per stack (21% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
